items.stem: Does high code coverage guarantee correctness?

options.text: No; it shows code ran, not that behaviour was verified
options.rationale: Correct: coverage measures execution, not assertion quality.
Code can run without being meaningfully asserted.
Even 100% execution does not verify behaviour.
The mocking tool does not change this.
